cases.input: Using Amazon's FY2017 consolidated statements of operations and consolidated balance sheets (fiscal year ended December 31, 2017), compute FY2017 days payable outstanding (DPO), defined as 365 × (average accounts payable at December 31, 2016 and 2017) / (FY2017 cost of sales + change in inventories from December 31, 2016 to December 31, 2017). Round to two decimal places (days).
cases.expected: 93.86 days. Source: AMAZON_2017_10K, Consolidated Balance Sheets, 'Accounts payable' 25,309 (2016) and 34,616 (2017), 'Inventories' 11,461 (2016) and 16,047 (2017); Consolidated Statements of Operations, 'Cost of sales' 111,934 (2017; note the columns run 2015, 2016, 2017 left to right). Average AP = 29,962.5; change in inventories = 4,586; denominator = 111,934 + 4,586 = 116,520; 365 × 29,962.5 / 116,520 = 93.86. GAAP inputs; in millions of USD, result in days; fiscal year ended December 31, 2017.
